title: Investigation of the anticancer activity of modified 4-hydroxyquinolone analogues: in vitro and in silico studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,3704-3720
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00252D, Paper
Open Access

Yousra Ouafa Bouone, Abdeslem Bouzina, Abdelhak Djemel, Sanaa K. Bardaweel, Malika Ibrahim-Ouali, Boulanouar Bakchiche, Farouk Benaceur, Nour-Eddine Aouf
4-Hydroxyquinolone analogues underwent in vitro cell proliferation test against 4 cell lines. Compound 3g showed a promising IC50 value against HCT116. Molecular docking and DFT predicted key parts of the molecule crucial for anticancer activity.
